# Copilot Skills

This directory is a scaffold for GitHub Copilot skill definitions.

## What belongs here

Skills package domain knowledge and tool sequences into reusable units that can be invoked by Copilot agents. Place `.md` skill files here along with any supporting assets.

## Status

Deferred — skill design will be addressed in a dedicated session.
